command:
/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
report = json.loads(Path('audit.json').read_text())
checks = json.loads(Path('audit_checks.json').read_text())
required = {'verdict', 'scores', 'total_score', 'load_bearing_gaps', 'checked_claims', 'rationale'}
assert required <= report.keys()
limits = {'correctness': 40, 'fidelity': 20, 'strict_progress': 15, 'calibration': 10, 'evidence': 10, 'reproducibility': 5}
assert report['scores'].keys() == limits.keys()
assert all(0 <= value <= limits[name] for name, value in report['scores'].items())
assert sum(report['scores'].values()) == report['total_score']
assert report['verdict'] == 'PASS' and report['load_bearing_gaps'] == []
assert len(report['checked_claims']) == 15
assert checks['total_checks'] == sum(checks['checks'].values()) == report['independent_checks']['total_exact_checks']
assert checks['counterexamples_found'] == 0
for name in ('TASK.md', 'CANDIDATE.md'):
    digest = hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert digest == report['input_sha256'][name] == checks['input_sha256'][name]
assert Path('audit.md').is_file() and Path('audit_checks.py').is_file()
print('Validated audit.json and audit.md; input hashes and 69,466 exact-check records agree.')
print('Verdict:', report['verdict'], 'Score:', report['total_score'], 'Load-bearing gaps:', len(report['load_bearing_gaps']))
PY"
